title: Which one fails?
examObjective: Applying correct syntax to write DataWeave transformations to coerce, format, order, and filter data
prompt: Three of these run. **One fails.** Which one?

explanation.approach: Text is joined with `++`, which also accepts a Number on either side. `+` is arithmetic: two numeric Strings are coerced and added, but "first" cannot be coerced, so that is the one that fails.

snippets.label: Two that look wrong but run
snippets.note: The first adds, the second concatenates a Number into text.
